title: manihot grahamii
intro: Manihot grahamii, commonly known as Graham's cassava or Graham's yam, is a plant species in the spurge family (Euphorbiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Manihot grahamii include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable plant for wound healing and pain management. Bioactive constituents present in Manihot grahamii include saponins, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
